senses.gloss: मुषाय muṣā-yá, den. P. steal, carry off (RV.).
मुष्क muṣ-ká, m. testicle: du. female organ: 🞄(a) -deśa, m. region of the testicles, groin.
मुष्टामुष्टि muṣṭā-muṣṭi, ad. fist to fist, 🞄fighting hand to hand.

मुष्टीकृ muṣṭī-kṛ, clench the hand;
 clench 🞄(hand).
मुस्त mus-ta, m. n., ā, f. kind of fragrant grass 🞄(Cyperus rotundus): (a) -ka, m. n., ā, f. id..

मूषिका mū́ṣ-ikā, f. rat, mouse: -ākṛti, 🞄a. shaped like a ratʼs tail;
 -utkara, m. 🞄mole-hill.
